Messages.Author: raul
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

A question about agg damage to Allies. What happen's to Allies.Agg Damage is
treated like regular damage?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <70esm3$bk6$1...@relay.eunet.es>, raul <rib...@tiasa.es> writes

>Hi all,
>
>A question about agg damage to Allies. What happen's to Allies.Agg Damage is
>treated like regular damage?
>

Normally, yes. Agg. damage dealt to an ally just causes it to burn life
instead of blood. I believe that an ally burns life equal to the damage
(2 agg damage = 2 life), because they don't become wounded etc.

However, a few allies won't burn life *unless* the damage is aggravated.
But these are all handled by card text. eg Ambrosius (the Giovanni
ally)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"raul" <rib...@tiasa.es> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> A question about agg damage to Allies. What happen's to Allies.Agg Damage is
> treated like regular damage?

Yes. Allies cannot heal damage of any kind - they simply lose life when
damage (regular or aggravated) is taken. [6.4.6]
